coverage.notes: Not included for Alaska: caribou, bison, muskox and wolf (ADF&G publishes them, but they are not HuntScout species keys) and brown/grizzly bear. Source: ADF&G Harvest General Reports (secure.wildlife.alaska.gov/DWC/HarvestInformation/GeneralReports), titled 'Interim ... Harvest Report' by ADF&G (subject to revision; RY2025 = July 2025-June 2026 may still receive late reports). year = regulatory year start (RY runs July 1-June 30). Unit codes exactly as ADF&G prints them ('01A', '13E', '02Z'); 'Z' marks a unit with no subunit letter in the record, and '27Z' is printed by ADF&G but is not one of Alaska's GMUs 1-26 and is not defined on the report page (kept as published, no unitName). Rows with method 'all' / methodLabel 'All hunts combined' are report 330 for all hunts (general season harvest tickets, drawing, registration, Tier I/II and community hunts together); residency 'resident'/'nonresident' rows are that residency's successful + unsuccessful hunters (ADF&G's 'Unspec' residency hunters are only in the 'all' row). ADF&G prints each count as a share of all hunters, not a success rate, so successPct = harvest/hunters (successComputed). harvestMale/harvestFemale from report 130 (its total can differ by 1 from report 330; noted per row). daysHunted is not stored: ADF&G's effort report 510 counts hunters differently from report 330 in many units, so its day totals do not pair with these hunter counts. 'Statewide' = the report's Total row. Rows with a hunt number are report 330 filtered to that hunt, one per unit where the hunt reported hunters (residency all; nonresident counts in the row note); methodLabel is the hunt type from the regulations' prefix legend (D drawing, R registration, T Tier II, C community, GM000 general season). Do not add hunt rows to unit rows: unit rows already include every hunt. ADF&G also prints a row with no unit (not stored, but included in Statewide): RY2020: 289 hunters/71 harvested; RY2021: 472 hunters/64 harvested; RY2022: 435 hunters/56 harvested; RY2023: 317 hunters/43 harvested; RY2024: 534 hunters/61 harvested; RY2025: 1072 hunters/233 harvested. Per-hunt reports had 135 no-unit rows (3119 hunters) that are not stored. 38 hunt-year reports returned no records (hunt listed on the form but no hunters reported).

ADF&G publishes hunters, male/female/total harvest and deer per hunter; it does not publish percent success, so successPct is null (deer per hunter in the row note; bag limits allow several deer, so harvest can exceed hunters). Only the GMUs ADF&G lists for each year appear. No statewide total is printed, so none is stored. '27Z' kept as published (not a GMU 1-26; undefined on the page). No residency or method split published.

bear = black bear only. Brown/grizzly bear is not one of HuntScout's species keys and is excluded. Source: ADF&G 'Black Bear Hunt Statistics (Reported Harvest)' per hunt number for General Season, Draw, Registration and Tier II (adfg.alaska.gov blackbearhunting.harvest); no Tier II black bear hunts were listed 2020-2025. ADF&G publishes black bear harvest per hunt, not per unit: the general season is one statewide hunt (GL000, stored as unit 'Statewide', general season only - not an all-hunts statewide total), and unit for drawing/registration hunts (DL018 1C, DL027/DL028 2, DL029/DL030 3, RL065 6D, RL450/RL460/DL455/DL457 14C) is read from the 2026-2027 hunting regulations, so hunt-area boundaries for 2020-2025 may have differed. successPct is ADF&G's published percent; licenses = '# of Permits' (harvest tickets for GL000); hunters = people who actually went hunting. ADF&G's per-GMU sealing records for black bear are not published in this form and are not included.
